sql.soql: SELECT SUM(valor_del_contrato) as total_value, COUNT(*) as total_count WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT'))

SELECT min(fecha_de_firma) AS date_min, max(fecha_de_firma) AS date_max WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) AND fecha_de_firma IS NOT NULL
SELECT nombre_entidad, count(*) AS cnt WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) GROUP BY nombre_entidad ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT modalidad_de_contratacion, count(*) AS cnt WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) GROUP BY modalidad_de_contratacion ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT date_trunc_y(fecha_de_firma) AS yr, count(*) AS cnt WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) AND fecha_de_firma IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr DESC
SELECT departamento, count(*) AS cnt WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) GROUP BY departamento ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT proveedor_adjudicado, documento_proveedor, tipodocproveedor, count(*) AS cnt WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) GROUP BY proveedor_adjudicado, documento_proveedor, tipodocproveedor ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id_contrato, referencia_del_contrato, nombre_entidad, departamento, ciudad, objeto_del_contrato, descripcion_del_proceso, tipo_de_contrato, modalidad_de_contratacion, valor_del_contrato, valor_facturado, estado_contrato, fecha_de_firma, proveedor_adjudicado, documento_proveedor, urlproceso WHERE (documento_proveedor = '71000001') AND (tipodocproveedor IS NULL OR tipodocproveedor NOT IN ('NIT')) ORDER BY fecha_de_firma DESC, valor_del_contrato DESC, id_contrato DESC LIMIT 5
